ouroboros.contracts.v1.AdmitMultimodalSo.description: AdmitMultimodalSourceRequest admits one bounded multimodal envelope.

caller.description: caller is untrusted payload identity to cross-check against authenticated context.

envelope.description: envelope is the versioned multimodal admission envelope.

idempotencyKey.description: idempotency_key distinguishes exact retries from conflicts.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.AdmitMultimodalSo.title: Admit Multimodal Source Request

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ArtifactRef.jsons.description: ArtifactRef identifies an immutable artifact without granting read access.

artifactId.description: artifact_id is an opaque artifact identity.

contentDigest.description: content_digest binds the reference to immutable content.

tenantId.description: tenant_id scopes the artifact identity and prevents cross-tenant reuse.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ArtifactRef.jsons.title: Artifact Ref

ouroboros.contracts.v1.AuthenticatedPrin.description: AuthenticatedPrincipalRef is an identity assertion emitted by a trusted boundary.

principalId.description: principal_id is never accepted as caller identity from an untrusted body.

sessionId.description: session_id identifies the authenticated session when a session exists.

tenantId.description: tenant_id is the authenticated tenant context.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.AuthenticatedPrin.title: Authenticated Principal Ref

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Digest.jsonschema.description: Digest identifies immutable bytes using a named digest algorithm.

algorithm.description: algorithm identifies the canonical digest algorithm, for example sha256.

hex.description: hex is the lower-case encoded digest value.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Digest.jsonschema.title: Digest

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Identifier.jsonsc.description: Identifier is an opaque, stable identifier within a declared namespace.

namespace.description: namespace prevents an identifier string from crossing a domain boundary.

value.description: value is opaque to consumers and must be non-empty after boundary validation.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Identifier.jsonsc.title: Identifier

ouroboros.contracts.v1.MultimodalSourceE.description:
MultimodalSourceEnvelope is the versioned multimodal admission envelope.
 It stores references and protected metadata, never plaintext payload bytes.
 It is deliberately distinct from Stage 03 AddSource / committed-Git sources.

brainId.description: brain_id prevents same-tenant cross-brain projection reuse.

byteLength.description: byte_length is the exact declared source byte count.

contentDigest.description: content_digest identifies exact immutable source bytes.

extractorIdentity.description: extractor_identity pins the certified extractor image/config digest.

kind.description: kind selects exactly one Stage 11 v1 modality family.
kind.title: Multimodal Source Kind

mediaType.description: media_type is the declared media type before decode.

pcmWav.description: pcm_wav bounds one PCM WAV audio file.

png.description: png bounds one standalone PNG image.

sourceObjectId.description: source_object_id is the connector- or upload-scoped object identity.

text.description: text bounds plain text or Markdown.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.MultimodalSourceE.title: Multimodal Source Envelope

ouroboros.contracts.v1.PcmWavBounds.json.description: PcmWavBounds freezes the Stage 11 PCM WAV admission limits.

byteLength.description: byte_length is the declared WAV size and must be <=250 MiB.

channels.description: channels is the channel count (mono or stereo in v1).

durationMillis.description: duration_millis is the declared audio duration and must be <=60 minutes.

sampleRateHz.description: sample_rate_hz is a positive PCM sample rate.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.PcmWavBounds.json.title: Pcm Wav Bounds

ouroboros.contracts.v1.PdfBounds.jsonsch.description: PdfBounds freezes the Stage 11 PDF admission limits.

byteLength.description: byte_length is the declared PDF size and must be <=25 MiB.

pageCount.description: page_count is the declared page count and must be <=100.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.PdfBounds.jsonsch.title: Pdf Bounds

ouroboros.contracts.v1.PngBounds.jsonsch.description: PngBounds freezes the Stage 11 standalone PNG admission limits.

byteLength.description: byte_length is the declared PNG size and must be <=20 MiB.

heightPx.description: height_px is the declared pixel height.

widthPx.description: width_px is the declared pixel width.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.PngBounds.jsonsch.title: Png Bounds

ouroboros.contracts.v1.TextMarkdownBound.description: TextMarkdownBounds freezes the Stage 11 text/Markdown admission limits.

utf8ByteLength.description: utf8_byte_length is the declared UTF-8 payload size and must be <=1 MiB.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.TextMarkdownBound.title: Text Markdown Bounds

ouroboros.contracts.v1.UntrustedMultimod.description: UntrustedMultimodalCaller carries body identity only for authenticated-context checks.

requestedPrincipal.description: requested_principal must match the authenticated peer principal and tenant.

requestedSession.description: requested_session must match the authenticated gateway session.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.UntrustedMultimod.title: Untrusted Multimodal Caller
